name: AWaRe Access
description: Access antibiotics that have activity against a wide range of commonly encountered susceptible infectious agents and a lower resistance potential than antibiotics in the other groups; selected Access antibiotics are essential first or second choice empiric treatment options for common infectious syndromes.

name: AWaRe Watch
description: Watch antibiotics that have higher resistance potential, including most of the highest priority agents among the Critically Important Antimicrobials for Human Medicine, and are key targets of stewardship programmes and monitoring.

name: AWaRe Reserve
description: Reserve antibiotics that are reserved for confirmed or suspected infections due to multidrug-resistant infectious agents and should be treated as last resort options.
